title: Smell Jars
shareTitle: Smell Jars — A Tiny Scent Apothecary
description: Lift tactile wooden lids, follow six colorful scent trails, and match each mystery jar to its picture token.
learningGoals: Connect sensory vocabulary with familiar ingredients
Practice visual matching and working memory
Build confidence through gentle, consequence-free retries
interactionModel: choose one of three mystery jars, tap its lid, then drag a picture token to the jar or tap the token and jar in sequence
feedbackModel: recorded teacher narration, distinct scent plumes, physical lid motion, gentle retry clues, tactile sound effects, and a four-token shelf celebration

modes.title: Smell & Match
modes.skill: match a persistent scent clue to one of three picture tokens

modes.title: Nose Memory
modes.skill: remember a fading scent clue and choose among four picture tokens
